title: The fold line of kbmon --status all for more than four sprints is one unbounded line, over 300 characters for five folded sprints, where every other row is about 100
goal: compact_lines keeps the fold line of the sprints topic within 120 characters, still naming each sprint that has run states

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import mon_status as m;rows=[{"id":"SP-%d"%n,"title":"Sprint number %d of the long running kind"%n,"items":{"done":1,"todo":1},"open":[{"id":"BG-%d"%n,"run":"blocked"}]} for n in range(8)];r=type("R",(),{"item":staticmethod(lambda i:i)})();out=m.compact_lines(rows,r);print([len(x) for x in out]);sys.exit(1 if max(len(x) for x in out)>120 else 0)
